executive_summary: This collection window (December 22-28, 2026, spanning the year-end/New Year's holiday period) is the twenty-seventh archived window overall. Fresh search again re-checked both carried-forward CFDA institutional questions and found no resolution to either. The CFDA/Vogue Fashion Fund 2026 winner remains unconfirmed by any dated, sourced coverage from CFDA.com, Vogue, WWD, Business of Fashion, or Fashionista -- this is now the tenth consecutive window this signal has been carried forward open, roughly ten weeks after the October 20 gala; is_prolonged_silence('cfda-vogue-fashion-fund-2026-winner', all_reports) continues to return True. The CFDA Fashion Awards question was also re-checked, again finding no confirmed 2026 date, nominee list, or post-event coverage distinct from the Fashion Fund; this is now the fifth tracked window for this signal_id, continuing past the archive's own four-window prolonged-silence threshold (crossed for the first time last window); is_prolonged_silence('cfda-fashion-awards-2026', all_reports) continues to return True. This is an observation about the pattern of both questions staying open across the holiday period, not new evidence about cause; no cancellation, delay, or outcome is implied for either. Separately, this window's search specifically checked for genuine, dated year-end 'best of 2026' retrospective coverage from legitimate fashion outlets (Vogue, WWD, Business of Fashion), distinct from evergreen or forward-looking 2026 trend-forecast listicles. None was found: available material was either early-2026 best-dressed coverage (January 2026 WWD Style Awards, Golden Globes, Grammys, BAFTAs), May 2026 Cannes/Met Gala recaps, or generic forward-looking '2026 trends' pieces with no publication date tying them to this window or framing them as a retrospective of the year just ending. No fashion week or resort/cruise runway content originates in this window per docs/EDITORIAL_CALENDAR.md. On balance this window is thin: two unresolved carried-forward institutional questions, both now past this archive's own prolonged-silence threshold, and no verified in-window style discourse or genuine year-end retrospective content.
